name: Otome Riron to Sono go no Shuuhen -Belle Epoque-
original_name: 乙女理論とその後の周辺 -Belle Epoque-
source:
This is the fandisc for Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen, which also requires you to have played the original title Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou. It features after stories for Resona and Meryl, as well an another story and after story for Bluette.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《少女理论及其周边》的粉丝碟，同时也要求玩家先玩过原作《月寄り添う乙女の作法》。本作收录了瑞穗和梅丽尔的后日谈，以及布鲁艾特的另一篇故事与后日谈。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
